goal: Replace the current procedural interior GLB props with AI-generated 2D-to-3D models made from MirrorLife's isolated interior prop sprites.
stylePrompt: Convert this isolated MirrorLife prop sprite into a clean game-ready low-poly GLB model. Preserve the warm dopamine cel-shading cartoon style, thick rounded silhouette, toy-like isometric mobile-game feeling, soft humanistic colors, clear readable shape, and transparent-background object identity. Generate only the object, no text, no labels, no extra scene, no people. Keep it lightweight for a browser Three.js game.
